entities.notes: Link Logistics was established by Blackstone in 2019 and is described as 'a Blackstone affiliate' / Blackstone portfolio company; capital comes from BREIT/BREP vehicles. Kearny: Link acquired the 10-acre former Talbot Hall Rehabilitation Center site at 100-140 Lincoln Highway in early 2021 and delivered a ~164,000 SF warehouse (Kearny township ribbon-cutting page: https://www.kearnynj.org/news/link-logistics-ribbon-cutting/). The asset later passed to Terreno Lincoln LLC (Terreno Realty affiliate) and was sold 2025-10-02 to B9 Lincoln Highway Owner LLC for $63.6M per bldup, so Link no longer holds it.
